$comment: THE canonical location data for crunchfitness.in.
This file is the ONLY place in the repository where a gym's name, address,
phone number or hours is written down. supabase/seed.sql is generated from
it (npm run seed:generate) and the app falls back to it only when Supabase
credentials are absent, so a developer can still boot the site locally.
Adding Faridkot later = add an object to `locations`, regenerate seed.sql,
insert the row, and set mgd_location_id once the branch exists in
